Results achieved:

[Context: Results achieved:]
Completed Energy Efficiency measures in 18 schools and kindergartens in 6 municipalities.

Created an enabling environment for renewable energy generation by supporting the Energy Regulatory

[Context: Created an enabling environment for renewable energy generation by supporting the Energy Regulatory]
Commission with the establishment of feed-in tariffs for renewable energy and development of rulebooks on

preferred generation from renewable energy sources.

[Context: preferred generation from renewable energy sources.]
Made financing available for energy efficiency/renewable energy investments by launching a credit line through the
Macedonian Bank for Development Promotion, which has financed several energy efficiency and renewable energy
projects including a 1 MW solar PV plant near Bitola.
Start up of the second phase of energy efficiency upgrades of schools and kindergartens covering a total of 14

institutions in five municipalities.

[Context: institutions in five municipalities.]
Started a wind measurement activity in five municipalities in the country.
